name: topic-guard
description: Before a prompt enters the session, a small model judges whether it belongs to the session's topic. When it starts a separate topic, the mod holds it in the prompt box: press Enter to keep it here, or New session to clear the session and send it there.

analyze.title: Judge each prompt
analyze.description: Before a prompt you type enters the session, ask a small model whether it belongs to the session's topic, and hold it when it does not. Off lets every prompt enter.

judge.title: Who judges the prompt
judge.description: model: the model below. jev: the Jev MCP (a server with a jev_classify tool, such as @jkudish/jev-mcp, which sends the end of the conversation and your prompt to the Jev provider); when it is not connected, fails, is blocked by the permission mode, takes over 4 seconds or is unsure, the model judges, and a toast says so when it fails. A blocked call also shows a notice with a button to switch to the model.

model.title: Model that judges the prompt
model.description: An alias (haiku) or a full model id. The call goes through the session's own client, and the prompt waits for it, up to 8 seconds. With judge set to jev, it judges only when Jev cannot.

minContextPercent.title: Context before the first judgment
minContextPercent.description: Judge a prompt only when the context window is at least this full, in percent. A small context costs little when topics mix. 0 judges every prompt.

recheckStep.title: Context growth after you keep a message
recheckStep.description: After you send a held message again to keep it here, judge again only when the context grew by this many percentage points. A context below that point, as after a compact, is judged again at once.

showStatus.title: Show the status line
showStatus.description: Pin a line under the prompt that says who judges (the model, or Jev and whether it is down) and the last thing the mod did, such as related at 45%. It never holds prompt text. Off shows nothing there.

debug.title: Write a debug log
debug.description: Write one line per judgment and choice to <temp>/claude-topic-guard/<session id>/debug.log: the session id, the context percent and the outcome, never prompt or reply text. Off writes nothing.
